riverland-22.name: Overland Corner
riverland-22.bio: National Trust's 1860 hotel and post office on the Murray, with displays, bush trails and fossils in the river cliffs.

notes.pin: Hotel at Old Coach Road, Overland Corner; Wikivoyage lists geo about -35.152, 140.34 (rounded, a hint only). Pin on the hotel itself, not the reserves.
notes.general: Free to enter the hotel and displays; meals and drinks are paid. Trading days vary (Tue-Sun per National Trust), so check before going. Draft said 'heritage museum': source says artefacts displayed throughout the hotel and Old Post Office.

riverland-23.name: Morgan
riverland-23.bio: Historic river port at the Murray's great bend, with the Landseer Museum, a railway museum and a heritage town walk.

notes.pin: Town centre (place=town) near the Landseer Building on Railway Terrace by the river; draft point is a rounded Wikipedia point, replace.
notes.general: Town is open access. Morgan Landseer Museum entry about $5 (SATC listing; an older local page said $4), weekdays, weekends by appointment: unverified current. Draft's 'restored paddle steamer' dropped: SATC only says a paddle steamer is slowly coming back to life, no name or access.

riverland-24.name: Morgan Conservation Park
riverland-24.bio: Riverside wetlands for birdwatching, fishing and picnics on the Murray near Morgan.

notes.pin: Park visitor/day-use point near the Murray wetlands (use a day-use area or boat ramp from OSM), not the park centroid.
notes.general: No day entry fee shown on the NPWS page (only camping, $15.40 per night). NPWS alert: park partially closed 18 May to 30 December 2026 for regulator construction works. Draft bio 'near Morgan' kept. Weak but named by the agency list.

riverland-25.name: Maize Island Lagoon Conservation Park
riverland-25.bio: Murray riverbank park with birdlife, western grey kangaroos, camping, fishing and the Peter Jacobs Trail.

notes.pin: Peter Jacobs Trail midpoint if in OSM, else the main river-track/campground access; not the park centroid.
notes.general: NPWS page: 'Free entry'. Peter Jacobs Trail and interpretive signs come from the SATC list via draft; NPWS page text does not mention the trail name (unverified).

riverland-26.name: Hart Lagoon Walking Trail
riverland-26.bio: Lagoon walking trail near Waikerie on the Murray, with birdlife and a camping area beside it.

notes.pin: Midpoint of the trail around Hart Lagoon (OSM way/route), halfway along its length.
notes.general: Listed on SATC Waikerie page with no price; treated as free open trail (council reserve). Bio keeps it generic: no source detail beyond 'lagoon walking trail'. Birdlife/camping claim: camping sites listed on same page; birdlife unverified.

riverland-26.ticket_note: No single official page found; council reserve trail.

riverland-27.name: Holder Bend Lookout
riverland-27.bio: Free clifftop lookout over a bend of the Murray near Waikerie, popular with photographers.

notes.pin: OSM tourism=viewpoint named Holder Bend, or the lookout car park on the cliff top.
notes.general: SATC lists it Free, with car park.

riverland-28.name: Headings Cliff Lookout
riverland-28.bio: Lookout near Paringa over 70 m of gold and ochre Murray cliffs, one of the Riverland's most photographed views.

notes.pin: OSM tourism=viewpoint Headings Cliff (near Paringa) or its car park on the cliff top.
notes.general: SATC lists it Free with car park and coach parking; '70 metres' and 'most photographed' are from SATC text.

riverland-29.name: Heaven Clifftop Viewpoint
riverland-29.bio: Free clifftop viewpoint above Habel's Bend, with a cliff walking trail and Murray views towards Katarapko.

notes.pin: Viewpoint at the cliff top above Habel's Bend (OSM tourism=viewpoint if named Heaven). Not on a Wikipedia page.
notes.general: SATC lists it Free. 'Cliff walking trail' and 'Katarapko' are from the Atlas draft note (the SATC listing page is thin): unverified. Official name has quotes ('Heaven'); shown name without.

riverland-30.name: Martin Bend Wetland and Walking Trail
riverland-30.bio: Wetland walking trail on the Murray at Berri, with a car park and toilets at the trailhead.

notes.pin: Midpoint of the Martin Bend wetland trail (OSM way/route in Martin Bend Reserve); trailhead car park as fallback.
notes.general: SATC lists Free, car park and public toilets. Trail length not sourced.

riverland-31.name: Wilabalangaloo Reserve
riverland-31.bio: National Trust nature reserve at Berri with a nature trail, a cliff-top viewing platform and 30 m ochre sandstone cliffs.

notes.pin: Reserve car park/trail start on the Murray side; midpoint of the nature trail is a pin option, not the reserve centroid.
notes.general: SATC Free. National Trust: 92 ha reserve on the Murray's western bank on Berri's outskirts, 1 km of about 30 m sandstone cliffs, cliff-top viewing platform. Trail length (about 2.5 km) from draft, not on the Trust page.

riverland-32.name: Monash Adventure Park
riverland-32.bio: Free adventure playground at Monash with a rope bridge, wooden maze, flying fox and a creek through the grounds.

notes.pin: 20 Madison Road, Monash: the park itself (OSM leisure=playground / park), not the Monash town point.
notes.general: Free entry (gold-coin donations welcomed, per a guide); address 20 Madison Road, Monash. Draft 'wiki: Monash Playground' dropped: no such article (the town article is Monash, South Australia); omitted. Barmera Visitor Centre page loaded.

milang.name: Milang
milang.bio: Lakeside township on Lake Alexandrina with a heritage jetty, the Port Milang railway museum and a historical walk.

notes.pin: Town centre place=town/village, not the jetty or museum; draft point to be checked.
notes.general: Town open access. Railway museum is free (weekends, hours unverified). State-heritage jetty is 217 m with a hand crane. Standalone spot (no destination).

milang.ticket_note: Town with many stewards; no single official site verified.
